description: Analyze legacy crossings (blast radius) for a passed CPFS task: detect pre-existing symbols the task modified, resolve their non-CPFS callers via a standalone language server (C-LSP — selected by file extension, auto-installed for npm-based servers), and scaffold one coverage task log. Falls back to symbol-existence-only ('basic blast-radius detection') when no language server is available. Returns the report + the dashboard blast-radius URL. Parity with the extension's analyzeLegacyCrossings command (vscode-coupled LSP → standalone-server LSP).

feature.description: Feature slug to analyze; omit for the active feature.

write_coverage.description: Scaffold a coverage task log from the crossings (default true, parity with the extension). Set false for a read-only report.

name: cpfs_analyze_legacy_crossings
